text:
Maya L.: Heads-up: prepping social for the 'Serving at Scale' webinar replay. Goal: drive replay views, capture config requests, and funnel high-intent accounts to SDRs. Need copy, hero GIF, 30s clip, carousel images, and SDR seed rules. Who can take what?
Jon F.: I can run scheduling + SDR workflow. Proposal: X AM post (metric lead), X PM post (customer lead), LinkedIn thread that unpacks the config w/ carousel. Also want an A/B test on the LinkedIn opener.
Priya S.: I'll draft copy. Quick preference check: more technical detail in first follow-up or save for the second?
Maya L.: Put the metric in opener, technical deep-dive in follow-ups. Keep CTA: "Watch replay + get the config".
Priya S.: Drafts below:
```
Opener A (metric): "Cut inference unit cost by 37% while keeping p95 latency <200ms. Replay + configs: [link] #inference #mlops"
Opener B (story): "They shipped features faster and halved infra surprises. Watch how in our 20-min replay. [link]"
```
Jon F.: We'll run A on X AM, B on X PM; LinkedIn uses A then threads into technical slides.
Marco R.: Design ask: hero GIF (1200x628, loop), carousel 4 images (1200x1200), 30s mp4 (16:9) for social. Need raw slides and demo screenshots.
Priya S.: Clip timestamps: 00:05 context, 00:12 batching explanation, 00:22 kernel tuning mention, 00:28 before/after cost graph.
Maya L.: SDR seedlist: webinar viewers (auto), replay clickers (UTM filter), trials with recent activity, and top-n named accounts. Route high-intent to AE queue if ARR > $10k or company in target verticals (FinServ, Health). Jon, can you codify?
Jon F.: Affirmative. Seed rules: viewers -> SDR-General, replay clickers + trials w/ activity -> SDR-Adv, named accounts + ARR>10k -> AE-queue. I'll push to CRM and add a zap to flag Slack channel #sales-inbound.
Jon F.: UTM canonical: utm_source=social&utm_medium=x&utm_campaign=serve-scale_q2. Use exactly.
ops-bot: Scheduled posts: X (metric) 2026-04-07T08:00Z, X (story) 2026-04-07T17:30Z, LinkedIn thread 2026-04-07T10:00Z. No scheduling conflicts.
Marco R.: Uploaded hero GIF draft -> https://drive.example/serve-scale/hero_gif_v1.gif. Feedback: make loop seam smoother and bold the cost delta.
Maya L.: @Marco please iterate v2 by EOD. @Priya once copy locked, order LinkedIn thread: opener, carousel image with quick bullet list, 30s clip, CTA with config link.
Priya S.: Draft LinkedIn thread for review:
"Cut per-inference cost without trading latency. TL;DR: batching + kernel tuning + targeted caching. Replay + full configs: [link]"
Jon F.: Approve to go once Marco v2 and final copy are in drive. I'll also set a 30-min listening window after AM post for SDR handoffs.
Marco R.: Noted. I'll push carousel assets and 30s clip by tomorrow 09:30 PT.
Maya L.: Quick ask: add a pinned reply on X that says "Need the config + test scripts? DM us or click replay" to catch infra/ops folks.
Jon F.: I'll add pinned reply and brief SDRs to monitor DMs and UTM clickers.
Maya L.: Final owners: Priya (copy), Marco (design & video), Jon (scheduling & routing), Maya (campaign lead). Thanks team 680 Check back when assets are uploaded.
